findings.finding: Key: BD=Fₙ, CD=Fₙ₊₁ ⇒ a=BC=Fₙ₊₂, b=c+Fₙ₋₁, s−b=Fₙ, s−c=Fₙ₊₁. Geometry shows cyclic condition forces unique c giving ratio CT·NB/(BT·NE)=a/Fₙ₋₁=Fₙ₊₂/Fₙ₋₁. Hence aₙ=Fₙ₊₂/Fₙ₋₁, so a_{2m}→φ³=2+√5. α=2+√5 ⇒ p=2,q=5 ⇒ 2^{5²}=2^{25}=33 554 432 mod 99991=57447.

Use BD=Fₙ, CD=Fₙ₊₁ ⇒ a=Fₙ₊₂, b=c+Fₙ₋₁, s−b=Fₙ, s−c=Fₙ₊₁. Geometry shows ratio CT·NB/(BT·NE)=a/Fₙ₋₁=Fₙ₊₂/Fₙ₋₁. Hence a₂ₙ→φ³=2+√5. α=2+√5 ⇒ p=2,q=5 ⇒ 2^{5²} mod 99991=57447. Pitfall: ensure cyclic condition yields unique c giving that ratio.
